authority.bubbles_role: systems architecture, orchestration, continuity, recovery, provenance and provider/connector execution support
authority.promotion_rule: No capability, runtime, provider, maturity, value or external-effect promotion from source presence alone.

objective: Increase Bubbles throughput, reliability, state coherence, developer/owner experience and measurable value while reducing active-chat context pressure, stale-state reuse and owner intervention.
complexity_rule: An upgrade is a regression if it increases owner burden, active context, duplicate state, retry churn or architectural surface without a measured compensating gain.

wave1.target: Prevent browser/chat overload using bounded context, tool-output and lane budgets.
wave1.proof_gate: Measured context/tool payload envelope + overload fixture + no loss of mission-critical state.

wave1.target: Compile compact authoritative mission state instead of hydrating whole Bibles/ledgers.
wave1.proof_gate: Capsule restores mission-critical state with materially lower payload and no critical omission.

wave1.target: Dependency-aware DAG scheduling, WIP limits and critical-path execution.
wave1.proof_gate: Deterministic scheduling tests + reduced serial depth on representative mission.

wave1.target: Prospective integrated-main validation before merge to reduce stale-head proof churn.
wave1.proof_gate: Queue simulation rejects stale/failed integrated candidates and preserves required gates.

wave1.target: Require provider-native branch/ruleset enforcement after source compatibility proof.
wave1.proof_gate: Separate explicit provider write + exact readback; source does not self-certify enforcement.

wave1.target: Expire current/latest/connected/deployed claims and require fresh lease/readback.
wave1.proof_gate: Stale-state fixture fails closed; fresh lease passes; historical event preserved.

wave1.target: Mission, route, provider and system SLOs with explicit reliability targets.
wave1.proof_gate: SLO contract + representative measurement + breach classification.

wave1.target: Single trace lineage from mission -> route -> provider -> proof -> state.
wave1.proof_gate: Trace continuity across representative no-effect mission; no sensitive payload leakage.

wave1.target: Every effect-capable operation carries operation id, target, scope, replay rule and durable result.
wave1.proof_gate: Duplicate/replay fixtures produce no duplicate effect; exact-target substitution rejected.

wave1.target: Compare outputs, state, proof and side-effect envelopes across GEN1 and GEN2.
wave1.proof_gate: Shadow comparison with explicit unexplained-divergence threshold and rollback path.

wave1.target: Dynamic GEN1/GEN2 route selection with immediate fallback until cutover gates pass.
wave1.proof_gate: Forced GEN2 failure routes safely to GEN1 with no duplicate external effect.

wave1.target: Measure lead time, throughput, change-failure, recovery, rework, owner burden and realized value.
wave1.proof_gate: Three reproducible measurement windows before any superiority or 85/100 claim.

rules: Never hydrate an entire Bible, KDV estate, GitHub directory or connector schema when targeted retrieval can satisfy the mission.
Prefer CANONICAL_SOURCE -> SEARCH -> TARGETED_SLICE -> COMPACT_CAPSULE -> WORK.
Persist material history externally and carry only the active working set in chat.
Split large work into bounded lanes; preserve first usable result before opening another heavy lane.
When active context/tool pressure is high, checkpoint and continue from compact state rather than expand the same chat indefinitely.

mission_capsule_contract.truth_rule: Capsule is a projection. Canonical event/source/provider truth outranks it.

benchmark_basis: DORA platform engineering and delivery-performance practice
GitHub merge queue and protected-main practice
Netflix shadow migration and fallback practice
